answer: Every claim climbs the bridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the garden re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the cipher of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
